meta.purpose: Derived statistical layer for the dashboard. Computed from results/v3-ext/*.csv; final_research.json and research.db are NOT modified.

undefinedMetrics.rule: PacketsReceived == 0 -> AverageDelaySec, AverageJitterSec and AverageHopCount (unless HopCountMethod == exact) are undefined
undefinedMetrics.excludedAt: aggregation layer only; raw CSV / research.db / final_research.json keep the stored placeholder 0

marginalDefinition.nodes: per (protocol, nodes): each seed's mean over its 9 traffic x mobility runs; CI across seeds
marginalDefinition.traffic: per (protocol, traffic): each seed's mean over its 18 node-count x mobility runs; CI across seeds
marginalDefinition.undefinedHandling: a seed with an undefined run for a metric is excluded whole for that metric
